          about

          FRIENDS HOUSE RECORDS
          PLOOPTOWN RECORDS
          RIV EDITIONS

          READ HERE: if you have questions in regards to merch , posters and cds are handled by the band , cassettes are handled by friends house records , and vinyl is handled by RIV Editions , for the vinyl you can find it on their bandcamp !!!!!

          ( Sophia here ): this album is a collection of stories from when i was a child to entering adulthood , covering the topics of sexual , physical , and mental abuse , drug addiction , and losing someone to suicide. This took 6 months to write and record , worked on in America , Canada , Germany , Portugal , England , Mexico , and Hong Kong. This project has involved over 20 people , and taken hundreds of hours. Thank you to all who listen , stay safe , and goodbye.
